keyFindings.text: **P0 — No schema file or contract document exists anywhere in the packet, so every record shape is prose in a REQ table and no builder can check a field name against a single source.** The packet holds fourteen phase folders and zero `*.schema.json` files; the only JSON under `specs/system-skilled-bots/003-openbot-parity-build/` is research state (`deep-research-config.json`, `findings-registry.json`, `frontier-nodes.jsonl`). Because 001, 002, 005, 006, 009 and 010 all add fields to the same three records, the folder belongs to a new cross-cutting phase (`015-contracts-and-schemas`) that lands before 001, not to any one child.

**Phase 007-per-bot-apps — P0: shared isolation can still expose every configured app.** The plan refuses a shared run only when the bot explicitly declares apps, but its data-flow note says a shared run resolves the pinned config from the checkout; the planned absent-declaration shared-run test explicitly accepts that the child reads the repository-wide config while the record says []. Close this in 007's spec/plan/acceptance criteria with an explicit default-deny rule and an absolute per-run UTCP_CONFIG_FILE for shared runs, or refuse connector-capable shared runs; add the corresponding absent/empty/explicit declaration matrix. Phase 007 already has a detailed module map, schema delta, adversarial matrix, integration tests and rollback, so it does not need a phase parent.
